description.narrative: The Project, in the middle of Heilongjiang province, is designed to promote sustainable economic growth by improving the Jixi-Nehe highway, a key trunk highway in the northeast. The Project will comprise (i) the upgrading of 428 km of the Jixi-Nehe highway, from class III or unclassified to class II or I; (ii) the improvement of rural link roads, totaling 170 km, to strengthen the integrated network in the project area; (iii) rural road maintenance; and (iv) equipment, consulting services, capacity development, and land acquisition and resettlement.

description.narrative: An efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly road transport system developed in Heilongjiang

The number of serious road accidents and fatalities in the project area reduced by 20% by 2015. Progress/Status: The number of road accidents/ fatalities/injuries in the reviewed 7 project counties was 1422/157 in 2007; and 1,168/114/803 in 2010, respectively. This corresponds with 18% and 27.4% reduction in number of accidents and fatalities, while 1.3% increase in injuries. Data Source: Accident statistics from the Heilongjiang Public Security Bureau and hospitals Actual value:

Vehicle operating costs for a car reduced from CNY1.48 per vehicle per km in 2005 to CNY1.23 in 2015 (2005 constant prices) Progress/Status: According to the project completion report mission estimates, vehicle operating cost for a car will reduce to CNY1.18 (constant price) by 2015. Data Source: Direct measures of vehicle operating costs by HPCD
Project Administration Manual (PAM), and Project Completion Report (PCR) Actual value:

Travel time between Linkou and Baiquan reduced from 12.5 hours in 2005 to 7.5 hours in 2015 Progress/Status: Travel time between Linkou and Baiquan reduced from 12 hours in 2005 to about 7.5 hours in 2011. Data Source: Traffic counts and travel time survey for the project highway and local roads by HPCD Actual value:

Villages with paved road access increased from 25% of the total in 2005 to 55% by 2010 Progress/Status: Number of villages with paved road access in Heilongjiang increased from 43% of the total in 2005 to 57% by 2011. Number of villages with paved road access in 8 project counties increased from average 61.6% of the total in 2005 to 76.3% by 2011 Data Source: Monitoring of accessibility by local communications bureaus Actual value:

Bus service coverage increased from 80% of townships in 2004 to 100% by 2015 Progress/Status: No specific data available for township. The rate of villages with bus service increased from 62.6% on average in project counties in 2005 to 92.6% by 2011, as compared with Heilongjiang total of 67% in 2011. Data Source: Monitoring of bus-related data by HPCD Actual value:
